text:
I don't want revenge. I just want distance.
Sometimes the best way to heal is to stop giving your energy to what hurt you.
Walk away. Breathe.
Let God handle what you can't control.
Eventually, you'll realize their actions don't have the power to disturb your peace anymore.
You don't need revenge when you've found peace.
